{{Top}}
[[File:CarbonFreezingRex-TC.png|thumb|right|250px|Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] undergoing carbon freezing]]
{{Quote|To freeze a being solid, then hang him on a wall like some trophy?|Han Solo, expressing his disdain with the Galactic Alliance's carbon-freezing methods|<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
'''Carbon-freezing''' was the process of freezing stored [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] to preserve it while it was being transported over long distances.

==Overview==
{{Quote|Oh, they've encased him in carbonite. He should be quite well protected. If he survived the freezing process, that is.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:Carbo_cut_away.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A cut away shows the inner workings of a carbonite block used for transporting tibanna gas.]]

In the freezing process, the gas was pumped into a freezing chamber where it was mixed with molten carbonite into a solid block. The gas was released later at its destination or at the processing center.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered the modification of a [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|freezing chamber]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] so that he could freeze [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;eliminating any chance of escape&mdash;to transport him to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. As a test, the process was tried on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who survived the freezing process through the use of a [[TCF32 carbonite encasement apparatus|special device]] and was eventually freed from his trap.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> 

Other people frozen in carbonite without their consent include [[Trioculus]], [[Antares Draco]], [[Chihdo/Legends|Chihdo]], [[Roni von Wasaki]], [[Sintas Vel]],<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> [[Valin Horn|Valin]]<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> and [[Jysella Horn]],<ref name="Outcast" /> [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]],<ref name="Death Sentence 2">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 2|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 2]]</ref> [[Grees]], [[Kenna]], [[Mathal]],<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> and [[Alliance Commander|The Outlander]].<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|Knights of the Fallen Empire}}</ref>  [[Czethros]] froze himself in Carbonite and [[Lorn Pavan]] was frozen by I-5YQ to survive an explosion and this method of survival was a success. Many people were killed and encased in carbonite, these included [[Groff Haugg]], [[Keto]], [[Mathal]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a large number of [[Carbonite Sith Army|Sith Troopers]] and possibly a [[Carbonite Sith Master|Sith Master]], frozen in carbonite, were discovered by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Silri]] with the help of a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] stolen from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] by [[Tyber Zann]].

Additionally, bodies were sometimes preserved in carbonite, as in the case of the [[Senatorial Tombs]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Carbon-freezing could induce [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]] after being released, as was the case with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back" /> The [[Alderaanian Medical Association]] established that inhaling carbon-freezing smoke was a health risk.<ref name="CCGsmoke">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Smoke Screen}}</ref>
